This pre-draft checkpoint remains distinct from the approval-time founderEditorialNovelty.ts gate.

docs/founder-signal-engine/editorial-novelty.md must document founderContentFingerprintGate.ts as a distinct pre-draft checkpoint from the approval-time novelty gate, state that its PASS carries no draft/approve/schedule/publish authority, and state that a PASS does not skip the approval-time novelty gate.
